meta.title: REAL JAPAN NOW — Not tourism. Join everyday life in Japan.
meta.description: Vintage shopping, home cooking and JDM night drives in Tokyo, hosted by verified locals. Small groups of 1–4 people. Available in English, 한국어, 繁體中文 and Français.
meta.keywords: Tokyo experience, local experience Japan, vintage shopping Tokyo, Japanese home cooking, JDM night drive, things to do in Tokyo

hero.title: Not tourism. Join everyday life in Japan.
hero.subtitle: Vintage shops with locals, home-cooked Japanese meals, midnight highway drives with JDM car owners. Experience the real Japan, at your own pace.

experiences.heading: 3 Experiences
experiences.lead: Pick one. Three to four hours with someone who actually lives here.

items.title: Vintage Hunting in Tokyo
items.description: Explore 5-7 vintage shops unknown to tourists with a local fashion enthusiast. Includes coordination advice to find your own unique Japanese style.

items.title: Home Cooking Experience
items.description: Cook and eat with a Japanese family at home. Experience "authentic home cooking" and Japanese food culture that you can't get from tourism.

items.title: JDM Night Drive & Photo Session
items.description: Night drive on the Metropolitan Expressway with a JDM car owner. Take professional-level photos at photo spots and deeply experience Japanese car culture.

items.title: Authentic Everyday Experience
items.body: Not tourist spots, but places only locals know. Relaxed atmosphere like spending time with friends.

items.title: Safety & Security
items.body: ID verification required for all participants. Only verified hosts provide experiences. 24-hour support system.

items.title: Small Group
items.body: Small groups of 1-4 people for personalized attention. Enjoy at your own pace.

items.title: Multilingual Support
items.body: Support in English, Korean, Traditional Chinese, and French. LINE customer support available.

flow.heading: How to Book
flow.lead: Seven clear steps, from choosing an experience to leaving a review.

steps.title: Choose Experience
steps.body: Choose your favorite from 3 experiences. Select date and number of people.

steps.title: Enter Personal Information
steps.body: Enter name, date of birth, nationality, and contact information.

steps.title: Submit ID
steps.body: Upload passport, residence card, or driver's license image. Encrypted and securely stored (automatically deleted after 30 days).

steps.title: Payment
steps.body: Full payment by credit card, LINE Pay, Apple Pay, or Google Pay.

steps.title: Booking Confirmation
steps.body: Confirmation email sent. LINE reminder the day before the experience.

steps.title: Enjoy the Experience
steps.body: Meet your host on the day. Enjoy the experience to the fullest.

steps.title: Submit Review
steps.body: Submit a review after the experience. Get a discount coupon for next time.

notices.heading: Important Notices Before Booking
notices.lead: Please read this before you book.

groups.title: Required Items
items: ID submission is required for all participants (passport, residence card, driver's license, or My Number card).
Vintage shopping & home cooking: 18 years and older.
JDM car experience: 20 years and older (driver's license required).
Full payment at booking. The cancellation policy applies.
Free cancellation up to 48 hours before the experience; 50% after that; 100% on the day.

groups.title: Health & Allergies
items: Home cooking: allergies and religious dietary restrictions must be declared in advance.
JDM car experience: pre-existing conditions and medication use must be declared in advance.

groups.title: Photo & Video Recording
items: Photos and video during the experience require the host's permission.
Posting on social media requires individual consent.
